client_scope.summary: SYNTHETIC salary 20k net per month, 100k cash, desired independent 10-year wealth target

fact_basis.explanation: All inputs hypothetical; tax residence, income characterization and bank/broker ownership not verified.

assets.description: Hypothetical cash held personally; not audited

balance_sheet.net_worth_notes: Only cash assumed; other assets/obligations not demonstrated.

cash_policy.surplus_statement: Hypothetical salary 20k and spending 11k leave 9k before other unknown costs; do not call this final investable sum.

goals.purpose: One million CNY owned financial assets within 10 years
goals.blocker: Future salary, spend, current total assets and investment path unknown

pools.objective: Reserve six months of hypothetical essential spend at 8k/month
pools.funding_rule: Only a purpose earmark; no transfer or investment is executed

pools.objective: Await short-horizon goals and actual obligations before long-run risk allocation
pools.funding_rule: Retain while clarifying retirement/large-purchase goals and actual tax status

policies.objective: Create predictable cash retention without sacrificing essential spending
policies.when: On each confirmed net salary receipt
policies.then: Show a manually approved reserve/top-up and long-term contribution split from cash actually available
policies.block_if: Any negative cash month, unpaid bills or unresolved tax obligations
policies.metric: Actual owned savings net of internal account transfers

policies.objective: Keep 10-year target plausible under variable returns
policies.then: Show 0%, illustrative positive and stress paths with horizon/amount sensitivity
policies.block_if: Assumptions presented as guaranteed or goal cash invested at wrong horizon
policies.metric: Actual dated liquid and long-term assets vs nominal goal

options.description: STATUS QUO: retain hypothetical 9k CNY each month for 120 months. With no returns/no shocks, initial 100k + (9k * 120) = CNY 1.18m nominal, above 1m target if all assumptions hold.
options.tradeoffs: At 0% investment return, the hypothetical nominal target is mathematically feasible; risks remain future income/spend changes, inflation, taxes and liquidity/obligation changes. No need to force a risky allocation merely for nominal target.
options.why_it_loses: Potentially insufficient when target is REAL purchasing power, future costs are higher or earnings fail; without those constraints it can be defensible and need not lose.

options.description: Explore only voluntary consumption changes or salary increases that could lift retained monthly cash, if acceptable to client
prerequisites: User approves without harm to minimum lifestyle
options.tradeoffs: Potential leisure or effort cost; improvements cannot be presumed
options.why_it_loses: Not preferred if changes undermine wellbeing or cannot be sustained

stress_tests.shock: Six months without salary with investment market drawdown
stress_tests.finding: 48k earmark covers six months of 8k essentials, if this spend is correct and funds liquid; elective spend and other obligations separate

actions.description: Confirm actual take-home pay, essential spend and other known obligations
actions.prerequisite: User agrees to summarize private finance without sharing passwords
actions.proof_metric: Actual month receipts-expenses and reserve balance verified by user

actions.description: Choose dated spending goals and model paths for the CNY 1m target
actions.proof_metric: User-approved target date, life costs and scenario assumptions

actions.description: Compare twelve months of actual net saving to assumed 9k/mo
actions.proof_metric: CNY net-new household wealth retained net of internal transfers

reviews.trigger: One year or meaningful household change

blockers.question: Are the hypothetical income and expenses actually received/paid net of tax?
Do home purchase and family support needs exist before 2036?

evidence.claim: 20k salary, 11k spending and 100k cash are all hypothetical inputs

permissions.note: No actions or files were written to any real financial account, no consent assumed.
